title: Mixing: We’re All Water, Woman Is The N****r Of The World by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Phil Spector

A mixing session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Some Time In New York City was held on 11 March 1972.

The recordings were mostly complete by this date, and the songs ‘We’re All Water’ and 18 March, and it was remixed the following day.

Page last updated: 12 March 2026

  • 1969: Mixing: Two Of Us, The Long And Winding Road, Lady Madonna

  • 1963: Radio: The Friday Spectacular
